description: Send a direct message from YOUR connected account. Costs $0.005 per action, drawn from your balance; billing turns on with the write go-live switch (free until then). Requires a connected account (account_connect). Optional: one attachment (an https url we fetch, or base64 data with filename and mime_type; at most 20 MB; PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, plain text, JPEG, PNG or GIF), and inmail: true with a subject to message someone outside your network (one credit each; 409 no_inmail_credits when none is left, nothing sent). An attachment or inmail send answers 503 temporarily_unavailable, with nothing charged, until it is switched on. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

attachment.description: One file, at most 20 MB: { url } (https) or { data (base64), filename, mime_type }.

inmail.description: true to message a person outside your network; needs subject.

person_ref.description: The person reference from a profile or search result.

subject.description: The subject line, with inmail: true only.

name: message_send
title: Send Direct Message
